name: Edging — Distraction Edging
summary: Just before climax, create a sudden or intense sensation away from the clit to shift focus and prevent orgasm. More subtle than pausing—uses mental redirection rather than complete stillness. Used by about 36% of edgers.
detailed_description: Distraction edging holds off orgasm by redirecting attention instead of stopping. A sudden or intense sensation elsewhere on the body pulls focus from the clit at the critical moment, letting the peak recede without fully halting play. It's a middle-ground method between the full stop of pausing and the fluidity of continuous edging.

safety_notes: Keep the distracting sensation pleasurable or neutral, not painful.
